function.arguments: {"index": 3, "status": "acted", "resolution": "The association between arm and severity is a confounding relationship. Because the treatment was not randomised and clinicians assigned treatment preferentially to sicker patients, any raw comparison of response rates between arms would be biased. To estimate the true treatment effect, we must stratify by baseline severity, compute the treatment effect within each stratum, and then combine the strata using standardisation (population-weighted average of stratum-specific differences). This ensures the estimate is adjusted for severity and not confounded by it."}
